# Plans and prices (from {{ site.url }}/consulting/)

- Advisor, $1,500 a month: a monthly strategy call, questions answered between calls, an AI roadmap kept up to date, and the monthly meetup. Cancel any month.
- Fractional AI Lead, $4,000 a month: everything in Advisor, a weekly call, Seth builds and runs your AI tools, agents and automations, and your team is trained on what is built.
- Embedded AI Team, $8,000 a month: everything in Fractional AI Lead, plus Seth and his AI agent team working for you on sites, content pipelines and custom apps, with priority response.
- AI Audit, $2,500 one time: two weeks looking at how your business runs, then a written plan of where AI pays off first.
- Team Workshop, $1,500 one time: a half-day, hands-on session where everyone leaves using AI on their real work.

# Work (from {{ site.url }}/case-studies/)

- A+ Garage Doors, three years: research-backed neighborhood pages, a Google rank report for every neighborhood, staff apps for the warehouse and sales, and a company knowledge base the team asks questions of.
- MemberPress.ai: an AI assistant that runs a membership site, plus the content, videos and launches around it.
- Garage Door Science: plain garage door guides for homeowners and team apps for garage door companies.
- Seth's own team of AI agents, which write, check and publish his sites, content and apps.
